trap.label: would para hábito
trap.wrong: We would to climb the tree.
trap.why: Em português “subíamos na árvore” é hábito e “morávamos” é estado. Em inglês would só serve para ações repetidas; estado exige used to ou passado simples.

opts: I would be tall as a child.

fix.wrong: She would be happy back then.
fix.right: She used to be happy back then.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would: “We climbed the tree every summer.”
rewrite.answer: We would climb the tree every summer.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com used to (estado): “I had a dog when I was a child.”
rewrite.answer: I used to have a dog when I was a child.
